criteria: authoritative Mature WDI Energy & Mining family and retained HTTPS evidence
same Norway territory, annual frequency and 1990-2024 requested window
durable local raw and normalized inputs with exact hashes
at least 30 retained observations and 0.85 coverage for each series
explicit missing-year and consecutive-year difference accounting
percentage-of-total denominator and percentage-point derived units
descriptive downstream utility without cross-series calculation or composition claim
no selection based on newly calculated level, difference, slope or variability outcomes
governing_question: What objective baseline evidence can the retained Norway fossil-generation-share and non-hydro-renewable-generation-share series support about coverage, missingness, finite-window levels, variation, and adjacent annual changes, without treating the two series as an exhaustive composition or making causal, predictive, policy, or cross-series relationship claims?
known_limitations: WDI mutable-source vintage limitation; retained bytes are the replay anchor
EG.ELC.FOSL.ZS is missing 2024; EG.ELC.RNWX.ZS is missing 2022-2024
the two shares are not exhaustive and must not be summed or treated as total electricity production
shared total-electricity-production denominator does not justify a relationship claim
finite ordered annual values are not random or independent samples
linear slope and first-difference descriptors do not establish trend structure, stationarity, persistence, explanation or forecastability
canonical decimal precision is representation policy, not source measurement precision
selection_reason: The retained Norway Energy & Mining pair is territory/window consistent, provider-unit explicit, above the published minimum coverage threshold, naturally incomplete at the tail, and useful for testing bounded missingness and calendar-adjacency semantics without calculating a relationship.
